written: before any measurement of this track (the only files in raw/ are the fixtures and the FP32 references, which hold no timing); never edited after a run
reason: Maintainer policy: a short screen first, stop early, report immediately. The full campaign costs about 70 minutes of exclusive machine time; the screen spends about 5 minutes to decide whether it is worth starting.
effect: Stop-only. The screen can end the campaign before block 1; it can never pass anything. Every gate, look, pair count and threshold of criteria.json r1 is unchanged, and no screen data enters any gate.

screen.arm_order: per cycle, split then gpu on even cycles and gpu then split on odd cycles (ABBA over consecutive cycles)
screen.window: criteria.json protocol.latency unchanged: 1 s idle, 2 discarded, 30 measured closed-loop requests, window P50; caller-observed latency
screen.laya_fast: one laya_fast_driver.py run right after, 3 cycles of the same 8x512 window (report and stop rule S3 only)
screen.correctness: the run's correctness pass (every 8x512 fixture request once per arm) against the FP32 reference, as in latency.py
screen.machine: as criteria.json protocol.machine: exclusive, AC power, the local LLM server and every other GPU/ANE consumer stopped

stop_rule.pairs: split window and gpu window of the same cycle: 6 ratios split / gpu of the window P50
stop_rule.S1_split_not_clearly_faster_than_mlx: SCREEN STOP unless every one of the 6 ratios is < 1.00 and their geometric mean is < 0.95
stop_rule.S2_correctness: SCREEN STOP if any split answer of the correctness pass or of a measured window has a hard mismatch against the FP32 reference
stop_rule.S3_clearly_slower_than_laya_fast: SCREEN STOP if the median of the 6 split window P50s is >= 1.10 x the median of the 3 laya-fast window P50s
stop_rule.otherwise: SCREEN CONTINUE: the campaign proceeds to the probe step and block 1 exactly as criteria.json r1 describes
stop_rule.reporting: A screen stop is reported as a screen stop with its numbers, not as a verdict on any gate. It says only that the preregistered campaign was not started.
